# agyn_agent (Resource)

Manages an Agyn agent.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "agyn_organization" "example" {
  name = "example-org"
}

resource "agyn_agent" "example" {
  organization_id = agyn_organization.example.id
  name            = "example-agent"
  role            = "assistant"
  model           = "gpt-4o"
  image           = "ghcr.io/agynio/agent-runtime:v1.0.0"
  init_image      = "ghcr.io/agynio/agent-init:v1.0.0"
  description     = "Example agent managed by Terraform."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `image` (String) Container image.
- `init_image` (String) Init container image.
- `model` (String) Model identifier.
- `name` (String) Agent name.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization identifier for the agent.
- `role` (String) Agent role.

### Optional

- `configuration` (String) JSON-encoded agent configuration.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description.
- `idle_timeout` (String) Go duration string for idle timeout (for example, "30s", "5m", "1h").
- `resources` (Attributes) Compute resource requests and limits. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID identifier of the agent.

<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Optional:

- `limits_cpu` (String) CPU limits (for example, 1).
- `limits_memory` (String) Memory limits (for example, 2Gi).
- `requests_cpu` (String) CPU requests (for example, 500m).
- `requests_memory` (String) Memory requests (for example, 1Gi).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID
terraform import agyn_agent.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
